priorityReview.title: Colesevelam for major LARS: pilot randomized placebo-controlled crossover trial
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Primary abstract verified; full publisher article inaccessible (HTTP 403), no PMC full-text identifier returned.
priorityReview.reason: 49 randomized but only36 per-protocol completers; LARS score did not significantly improve. Exploratory composite and BAM subset cannot replace the main negative result. Complete safety, prespecification, crossover carryover/period analysis and missing-data handling await full text.

priorityReview.title: Local excision versus ISR after nCRT: response-selected two-center cohort
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Publisher full article and tables read.
priorityReview.reason: Historical October29 paper newly indexed.367 patients,147 matched(LE56/ISR91); response selection not included in matching, overlap with prior106-patient cohort, no functional or permanent-stoma outcomes. Table4 labels a simultaneous-covariate model univariable; clarify Cox-model attribution and distinct log-rank/Cox P values before structured effect extraction. Non-significance does not establish equivalence.

priorityReview.title: KEYSTEP-008 pembrolizumab/quavonlimab versus pembrolizumab: historical registry results
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Complete public registry read; primary results June8,2026, not a November new readout.
priorityReview.reason: 302 randomized across treated/untreated cohorts. Prespecified any-AE and AE-discontinuation outcomes NOT_POSTED; SAE table is not equivalent. Last ORR comparison duplicates OG002/OG006 labels with a different estimate. Preserve uncertainty until safety and group mapping resolved.

priorityReview.title: Elimusertib plus FOLFIRI phase I: early closure for toxicity
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Historical2025 primary full paper and registry results read.
priorityReview.reason: 10 mixed-GI participants, only6 CRC; early termination for toxicity, MTD not established. Abstract reports4 DLT versus5 in text/patient table. Registry ORR/CBR nominal denominators differ from6 evaluable patients and some AE risk denominators are inconsistent. Retain negative signal; do not present mixed-cancer PFS as CRC-specific.
